label: Cast a Spell
description: When you attempt a spell under pressure, say the incantation, make the gesture, and roll +Practice.

bands.text: The magic does what you meant it to do, cleanly and fully.
The magic works, but choose one: you draw unwanted attention; it has a minor unintended side effect; or it drains you, and you mark 1 Stress.
The magic slips, fails, or does something else. The GM makes a move, and a big working may mark Stress or cause a mishap.

label: Research & Study
description: When you search the archives, consult a text, or analyze an unknown magical thing, roll +Theory.

bands.text: Ask the GM two questions about the subject. The answers are true and useful.
Ask the GM one question. The answer is true, but it comes with a cost or a complication: a missing page, a dangerous source, or a favour owed.
The information is incomplete, misleading, or guarded. The GM makes a move.

label: Lab Work
description: When you prepare a compound, brew an elixir, or transmute materials in a proper or improvised lab, roll +Alchemy.

bands.text: The batch is potent and does exactly what you intended.
It works, but it is unstable, temporary, or missing a rare final ingredient. Choose one; the GM says what it means.
The work fails, spoils, or goes somewhere dangerous. The GM makes a move.

label: Break Curfew / Bend Rules
description: When you sneak past wards, prefects, or faculty, or attempt something forbidden, roll +Cunning.

bands.text: You get in, get out, or get away clean.
You get what you wanted, but leave a clue, draw a witness, or meet an obstacle on the way out. The GM says which.
You are caught, cornered, or forced to abandon the attempt. The GM makes a move.

label: Charm / Negotiate
description: When you persuade, flatter, bargain, or work a room, roll +Charm.

bands.text: They agree, help, or let you pass, and they do not hold it against you.
They agree, but they want something first, or someone else notices the favour.
They refuse, take offence, or raise the price. The GM makes a move.

label: Duel
description: When you face another spellcaster in a formal or informal duel, roll +Practice for each exchange.

bands.text: Your spell lands cleanly, and your opponent is off balance.
Choose one: both spells land; both miss and the exchange resets; or you land a hit but take a cost, such as a Condition, a lost wand, or a marked uniform.
Your opponent's spell lands, and the GM makes a move. A duel is rarely to the death, but it can still hurt.

label: Play the School Sport
description: When you have control of a school match and your team is about to make a risky play, roll +Practice if you play boldly or +Cunning if you play dirty.

bands.text: Your team scores, and you keep control of the match.
Neither team scores, or your team scores but loses control. The GM says which, and the match moves on.
The other team scores. The GM makes a move, and the crowd has an opinion.

label: Help or Hinder
description: When you help, defend, trip up, or interfere with someone, roll +Charm. If they are a Friend or Rival, add +1.

bands.text: Give them +1 or -1 to their next roll, or prevent them from taking a Condition.
They get the bonus or penalty, but you take a Condition, draw attention, or owe someone an explanation.
Your help backfires or your hindrance is noticed. The GM makes a move.

label: Stand in the Face of Danger
description: When you stand firm against a threat, physical or magical, roll +Practice if you meet it head-on or +Cunning if you outwit it.

bands.text: You hold, and nobody you are protecting gets hurt.
You hold, but choose one: you take a Condition; someone else takes the harm; or the threat backs off and comes back later.
The danger gets past you. The GM makes a move.

label: Approach a Magical Creature
description: When you try to tame, help, bargain with, or get help from a magical creature, roll +Charm.

bands.text: The creature does what you want, or gives you what you need.
It does what you want, but you take a Condition, it attracts attention, or it wants something first.
The creature panics, turns wild, or decides you are the problem. The GM makes a move.

label: Use a Magical Object
description: When you use an enchanted object under pressure, roll +Theory if you understand it or +Practice if you force it.

bands.text: The object works exactly as you expected, and you get the most from it.
Choose one: it does something unexpected but helpful; its effect is weaker or shorter; or using it costs you, and you mark 1 Stress.
The object fails, misfires, or does what it wants. The GM makes a move.

label: Brew a Potion
description: When you brew a potion you know, with the right ingredients and tools, roll +Alchemy.

bands.text: You make the potion, and it keeps its strength.
You make it, but choose one: it has a side effect; it will spoil by the next scene; or you need one more ingredient to stabilize it.
The brew spoils, smokes, or spills. The GM makes a move.

label: Forge an Enchantment
description: When you place an enchantment you know on a suitable object, roll +Alchemy. You need the object, the materials, and uninterrupted time.

bands.text: The enchantment takes hold in the object and does what you designed.
It works, but choose one: the object has a flaw the GM names; the working is tied to one person or place; or it will fade after a few uses.
The magic refuses, twists, or takes something from you. The GM makes a move.

label: Study for an Exam
description: When you cram, revise, or prepare for a test, roll +Theory.

bands.text: You are ready. Take +1 forward on the exam, and you know which topic the examiner will favor.
You learn enough to pass, but choose one: you are exhausted; you neglected a friend; or you missed a topic the GM names.
The material will not stick. The GM makes a move, and the exam will find the gap.

label: Attend a Class Challenge
description: When you take on the challenge a class sets, roll +Theory for a lesson of the mind, +Practice for a lesson of casting, or +Alchemy for a lesson of making. The GM frames the challenge and names the stat.

bands.text: You complete the challenge. Mark 1 progress on the class project and say what you learned.
You complete it with a cost: mark 1 progress, but take a Condition, draw attention, or leave something behind.
The challenge beats you for now. The GM makes a move, and the class project does not advance.

label: Play a Prank
description: When you set up a trick, a diversion, or a beautiful piece of mischief, roll +Cunning.

bands.text: It lands perfectly, and the right people laugh.
It lands, but someone sees you, a target is angrier than you meant, or a teacher starts asking questions.
It backfires, is traced to you, or catches the wrong person. The GM makes a move.

label: Cast Your Signature Spell
description: When you cast the personal spell written in your Signature Spell field, roll +Practice.

bands.text: The spell does what it was made to do, and the flourish is unmistakably yours.
It works, but choose one: it is more dramatic than you wanted; it costs you 1 Stress; or someone who should not have seen it did.
The spell turns inward or sideways. The GM makes a move, and the mark it leaves is personal.
